name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
limits: ARM capacity varies by region. Idle instances can be reclaimed after 7 days below 20% CPU/network/memory use; accounts may be suspended after 30 days idle.
notes: Also includes 2 AMD micro VMs with 1GB RAM each and 200GB total block storage. Always Free, no time limit.

name: Google Compute Engine
limits: One e2-micro VM only in us-west1, us-central1, or us-east1. Includes 30GB standard disk and 1GB outbound data per month.
notes: Always Free; a billing account is required, but the e2-micro instance is not charged.

name: Google Cloud Shell
limits: 50 hours per week. Sessions end after 20–60 minutes idle and last at most 12 hours; the 5GB home disk is deleted after 120 days of inactivity.
notes: Boost mode gives 4 vCPU and 4GB RAM. The larger boot disk is temporary; only the 5GB home is persistent.

name: GitHub Codespaces
limits: 120 core-hours per month (about 60 hours on 2 cores) and 15GB-month storage. Stops after 30 minutes idle; 12-hour maximum per session.
notes: Default 2-core / 8GB machine shown. Larger machines use the free quota faster; no card is needed unless you exceed it.

name: CodeSandbox
limits: 400 credits per month (about 40 hours on the Nano VM). VMs freeze when credits run out; idle projects are cleaned up after 8 days.
notes: Free Nano VM has 2 cores, 4GB RAM, and 20GB disk. Credits reset monthly.

name: Lightning AI
limits: CPU Studio sleeps after 10 minutes idle and restarts every 4 hours. One active free Studio and a 50GB storage limit.
notes: Free tier is CPU-only; GPU credits are one-time. No card required.

name: Deepnote
limits: Shuts down after 15 minutes of inactivity, with an 8-hour continuous runtime limit. Free plan includes 5 projects and 3 editors.
notes: Free workspace has 5GB RAM and 2 vCPU. Disk size is not published.

name: Xshellz
limits: Free shell is a 7-day always-on trial. It pauses after 7 days, needs manual extension every 2 weeks, and config is kept for 30 days.
notes: Free plan has 0.5 vCPU, 512MB RAM, and 300MB disk. Running servers are prohibited and free shells are often unavailable.

name: Google Colab
limits: Sessions end after about 12 hours or sooner when idle. No SSH or always-on service; free resources vary with demand.
notes: Free notebook VM with roughly 2 vCPU, 12GB RAM, and temporary disk. Not a full VPS.

name: Kaggle Notebooks
limits: 12-hour session limit (9 hours on TPU) and disconnects after 60 minutes idle. GPU quota is about 30 hours per week.
notes: Free CPU notebook has 4 vCPU, 29GB RAM, and 20GB disk. Phone verification is needed for GPU and TPU.
